visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide establishing shot of a paved asphalt road stretching toward a prominent, dark, cone-shaped mountain under a clear, bright blue sky. On both sides of the road are traditional Japanese residential houses with dark-tiled roofs and white walls. No characters are present in this initial outdoor scenery, but yellow captions appear at the bottom center of the frame. (2) A woman with long dark hair, dressed in a white winter parka with a fur-lined hood, black leggings, and black leather boots, is shown walking away from the camera. She enters a wooden gateway leading to a traditional Japanese building with a white noren curtain hanging over the doorway featuring black calligraphy. The garden setting has manicured trees and stone paths. (3) Inside a room with traditional tatami flooring and shoji paper screens, a man in a dark navy sweater and a woman are seated at a wooden dining table. They hold up wine and champagne glasses in a toast. Close-up shots feature gourmet dishes, including a creamy white soup topped with herbs and a seared fish fillet served with greens and a balsamic glaze. A bouquet of vibrant red flowers in a heart-shaped box is displayed on the table. (4) The woman hands a white paper-wrapped package to the man, who unwraps it to reveal several heart-shaped and cherry blossom-shaped chocolates on sticks. They are sitting in a well-lit interior with soft natural light. Later, the couple is seen sitting at a low table in a room with traditional sliding doors, both focused on their respective laptop computers. (5) The final sequence occurs at night on an outdoor tennis court illuminated by bright stadium lights. The woman, now wearing a light grey sweatshirt and dark athletic pants, is seen swinging a tennis racket. An older man with grey hair, wearing a blue jacket, stands nearby on the court, feeding her tennis balls during a practice session.
